summary: CLI commands trigger exactly one state machine transition. Additional mutations (entity creation, activity log appends, directory creation) are RPC-layer side effects, not state machine events. This guarantees that nextCommands can be derived from the transition table alone.
title: Every CLI command maps to exactly one state machine transition

summary: CI builds the plugin and pushes assembled artifacts to a release branch at plugins/gp/. The marketplace manifest uses git-subdir with ref: release to point at that path. Users get a sparse clone of just the plugin directory. No separate distribution repo needed.
title: Distribute plugin via release branch in source repo using git-subdir
